# I could run more virtual brands than my kitchen can handle. Which do I keep?

> Free tool for ghost kitchens and delivery-only restaurants running several virtual brands with limited kitchen hours: get the exact most profitable set of brands after food cost, delivery-app fees, packaging and labour. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
